clauses.title: Scope – Requirement of prelaminated medium
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirement of prelaminated medium density fibre board for general purposes and also for special applications.

clauses.title: Grades and Types –
clauses.text: 2. Grades and Types - Based on surface  abrasion characteristics.  The grades and types of prelaminated medium density fibre boards shall be represented by symbols as follows : Grade and Type Designation Grade I Type I PLMDF-11 Type II PLMDF-12 Type III PLMDF-13 Type IV PLMDF-14 Grade II Type I PLMDF-21 Type II PLMDF-22 Type III PLMDF-23 Type IV PLMDF-24

clauses.title: Medium Density Fibre Board
clauses.text: 3.1 Medium Density Fibre Board —Synthetic resin bonded medium density fibre board  shall conform to IS  12406 : 1988 +

clauses.title: Impregnated Base Paper –
clauses.text: 3.2 Impregnated Base Paper - Printed or plain colour absorbant basepaper having a weight of 60-140 g/m2 impregnated in a suitable synthetic resin and dried to a volatile content of 4-8 percent shall be used: 3. Impregnated Overlay - An absorbant tissue paper having a weigth of 18-40 g/m3 impregnated in a suitable synthetic resin and dried to a volatile content of 4-8 percent, shall be used.

clauses.title: Finish
clauses.text: 4. Finish — The finish of the paper overlaid board depends on the surface of caul plates used. .

clauses.title: Dimensions and Tolerances
clauses.text: 5. Dimensions and Tolerances —Dimensions and tolerances shall conform to IS 12049 : 1987 ++

clauses.title: Resistance to Steam
clauses.text: 6.3 Resistance to Steam — Shall not  show any sign of blister, delamination or   change in surface finish. There many be slight colour change in dark colour/patterns.

clauses.title: Crack Resistance – Shall
clauses.text: 6.4 Crack Resistance - Shall not show  any sign of cracks or delamination.

clauses.title: Resistance to Cigarette Burn
clauses.text: 6.5 Resistance to Cigarette Burn — Shall not leave any mark or stain on the specimen after cleaning with water or solvent.

clauses.title: Resistance to Stain
clauses.text: 6.6 Resistance to Stain — Shall not leave any stain on the specimen after cleaning with  water , solvent or detergent.

clauses.title: For
clauses.text: 6.7 For  Other Tests - See Table 1 Note: For methods of tests, refer to various parts of IS 2380 : 1977  Methods of tests for wood particle boards and boards from other lignocellulsic materials (first revision). For  detailed Information, refer to IS  14587:1998  Specification for prelaminated medium density  fibre board.
